faq.heading: Gallery questions, answered.
faq.subheading: HIPAA, consent, performance, and what it takes to launch.

items.q: How do you handle HIPAA and patient consent?
items.a: Every case requires a scoped, timestamped e-consent capturing separate permissions for web, print, and social use — with a revocation flow that removes the case within 24 hours. All consent records are stored with an audit trail.

items.q: Can I filter cases by provider, treatment, and skin type?
items.a: Yes. Every case is tagged with concern, treatment protocol, Fitzpatrick skin type, severity, provider, and elapsed time. Visitors filter live with URL-shareable results — great for referral emails.

items.q: What image quality and consistency do you require?
items.a: We provide a photo protocol (angle, distance, neutral background, controlled lighting) plus an optional in-clinic training. Our system flags inconsistent uploads before they go live.
Yes. Touch-drag, pinch-scale, and swipe-between-cases are all optimized for mobile at 60fps. Slider handle meets 44px touch-target guidelines and reduced-motion preferences are respected.

items.q: Can we show surgical outcomes (Mohs, excisions)?
items.a: Yes — with staged healing timelines (Week 2 / Month 1 / Month 3 / Month 6) and optional content-warning gating. Referral-friendly case notes attach to every surgical case.

items.q: Will the gallery slow down my site?
items.a: No. Images are lazy-loaded, served in AVIF/WebP from CDN, and progressive-blurred. Galleries typically maintain 95+ Lighthouse Performance.
